audit_metadata.document_title: Phase 8 Final Evidence-Based Acquisition Gate Review
audit_metadata.scope: Forensic asset-level legal, physical availability, and privacy controls review

SRC-01.name: Roboflow Car Damage V5
SRC-01.platform_terms_summary: Roboflow Terms Section 4 & 8 disclaim all title warranties; uploader warrants rights, but platform performs zero provenance verification

SRC-02.name: DrBimmer / Humans in the Loop
SRC-02.declared_license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Root Institutional Release) / MIT (Hugging Face Mirror)
SRC-02.platform_terms_summary: Humans in the Loop officially dedicated raw images and polygon annotations to public domain worldwide under CC0 1.0 Universal deed

SRC-03.name: Kaggle COCO Car Damage (anujms)
SRC-03.platform_terms_summary: No open-source license tag on dataset card; community web scrape from 2018; photographers retain All Rights Reserved

SRC-04.name: Kaggle Car Damage Assessment (lplenka)
SRC-04.platform_terms_summary: Physical dataset contains exactly 80 total images (59 train, 11 val, 8 test) and zero flat tires

SRC-05.name: Kaggle Insurance Claims (vinayjose)
SRC-05.platform_terms_summary: Apache 2.0 applies to code contributions; uploader compiled insurance claim photos without copyright assignments from carriers or policyholders

SRC-06.name: Wikimedia Commons Automotive Damage Collections
SRC-06.declared_license: Individual per-file deeds: CC0, Public Domain, CC BY, or CC BY-SA
SRC-06.platform_terms_summary: Every file audited via MediaWiki Action API; CC BY-SA files strictly disqualified to prevent copyleft contamination

estimates.screening_fallout_rate_pct: 25.0% to 35.0% based on automated blur, resolution, and PII conflicts
estimates.staged_candidate_intake_needed: 320 to 350 raw candidate images to yield 235 usable validation images

assumptions.co_occurrence_distribution: Estimated average of ~2.0 verified damage instances per collision photograph based on historical multi-panel crash physics
assumptions.fair_use_defense_viability: Internal machine learning validation within an access-controlled quarantine satisfies 17 U.S.C. § 107 Fair Use factors for computational analysis, provided zero public redistribution or commercial packaging occurs
assumptions.redaction_preservation: Bounding box dilation of 15% around detected license plates and VINs will capture reflective flares while occluding less than 20% of adjacent panel damage

unresolved_items.copyleft_weight_derivation: Unsettled legal debate whether neural network weights constitute 'Adapted Material' under CC BY-SA 4.0; permanently mitigated by categorically excluding CC BY-SA files
unresolved_items.uploader_copyright_authority: Roboflow V5 (Erkans Workspace) and Kaggle Claims (Vinay Jose) uploaders lack documented copyright assignments from original photographers
unresolved_items.contextual_reidentification: Potential residual PII under GDPR Recital 26 arising from unique bumper stickers, commercial fleet graphics, or distinctive background residences
unresolved_items.trademark_nominative_use: Manufacturer emblems in damage inspection photos are protected under nominative fair use, but no explicit trademark disclaimers are attached to raw photos

SRC-01.primary_evidence: Uploader chosen CC BY 4.0 without proof of image copyright
SRC-01.conditions: Quarantined for internal offline evaluation only; zero external redistribution; mandatory solid PII masking

SRC-02.primary_evidence: Root institutional CC0 1.0 Universal public domain dedication by Humans in the Loop officially verified
SRC-02.conditions: Primary anchor source; apply standard EXIF wipe and solid license plate masking; cite Humans in the Loop in manifest

SRC-03.primary_evidence: No open-source license tag on Kaggle card; unlicensed 2018 web scrape

SRC-04.primary_evidence: Scale is only 80 images total with zero flat tire instances; statistically insignificant
SRC-04.conditions: Deprecated from allocation to eliminate administrative overhead

SRC-05.primary_evidence: Apache 2.0 attached to code/CSV, not third-party insurer claim photos
SRC-05.conditions: Quarantined for internal offline evaluation only; zero external redistribution; mandatory solid PII masking

SRC-06.primary_evidence: Per-file verified CC0, Public Domain, or CC BY contributor deeds on Wikimedia Commons API
SRC-06.conditions: Primary anchor for flat tires and hail dents; strict automated exclusion of CC BY-SA files; maintain attribution log

required_evidence_before_unlock: 1. Scripted API validation generating candidate manifest verifying 100% of Wikimedia candidate URLs carry CC0, Public Domain, or CC BY (zero CC BY-SA).
2. Formal sign-off on Internal Fair Use Quarantine Protocol for SRC-01 and SRC-05 auxiliary datasets.
3. Automated bounding box dilation (15%) test verifying solid zero-entropy masking ([0,0,0]) over sample plates without damaging defect features.
4. Separate explicit user authorization to begin Stage 1 raw image downloads.
